entries.name: Say It Better
entries.blurb: Select any text, press ⌥Space, pick a tone. It fixes the words, you keep the credit.

howItWorks.title: Select some text
howItWorks.detail: In Mail, Messages, Slack, Notes, a web form: anywhere you type.

howItWorks.title: Press ⌥Space and pick a tone
howItWorks.detail: Firmer but friendly, nicer, shorter, funnier, more formal, or just fix typos.

howItWorks.title: Replace it
howItWorks.detail: Press ↵ and the new version drops right in. Your clipboard is left exactly as it was.

goodToKnow: Only the text you select is sent to the AI.
Turn on "Sounds like you" in Settings and it learns your voice, on this Mac only.

entries.name: Explain This
entries.blurb: Jargon, charts, fine print. Plain English, right where you are.

howItWorks.title: Select something confusing
howItWorks.detail: A bill, a contract clause, a medical letter, a dense email.

howItWorks.title: Press ⌥E
howItWorks.detail: Get a plain-English explanation, plus what it means for you.

howItWorks.title: Ask one follow-up
howItWorks.detail: Still unsure? Ask a quick question right in the panel.

goodToKnow: Only the text you select is sent to the AI.
It explains; it never changes your text.

entries.name: Fridge Chef
entries.blurb: Snap your fridge. Three dinners you can make tonight.

howItWorks.title: Show it your fridge
howItWorks.detail: Drop in a photo, pick one, or take one with your iPhone.

howItWorks.title: Fix anything it got wrong
howItWorks.detail: Tap an item to rename or remove it, and tick what's in your pantry.

howItWorks.title: Pick a dinner and cook
howItWorks.detail: Cook mode shows one big step at a time, with timers.

goodToKnow: Photos are shrunk and stripped of location data before they're sent.
Only the item names are used to find recipes.

entries.name: Bedtime Stories
entries.blurb: Your kids are the heroes. Illustrated and read aloud.

entries.name: The Decider
entries.blurb: Two options in. A clear verdict out, and what would change it.

entries.name: Form Filler
entries.blurb: Never write your address on a form again.

entries.name: Paperwork
entries.blurb: Bills and letters, filed and on time.

entries.name: Tidy My Mac
entries.blurb: A cleanup plan you approve, one tap at a time.
